The exact compatibility relation is reconstructed by checking third edges, yielding 1120 forbidden pairs; the verified C++17 ordered backtracking with a provably sound greedy-coloring clique bound counts 80 twelve-cliques and zero thirteen-cliques. Every larger clique would contain a thirteen-clique, so the upper bound is exact. A four-center geometric construction yields twelve legal edges; separate exhaustive-vs-geometric set equality, the symbolic 32*10*2/8 census and automorphism action establish every extremizer and one orbit. The supplied program compiled and ran with VERIFY_OK. No result outside Q5 is claimed.

value.rationale: The 2024 primary Table 1 gives only a lower bound 10 for Q5, while its exact hypercube theorem applies at power-of-two dimensions. The precise small five-cube packing and all 80 optimizer configurations close a natural first post-Q4 finite case and clarify extremal induced-star forest and injective edge-coloring geometry.
